subject: Packages not found when I run an app on my shiny-server (but availabe in Rstudioserver)

messages.author: a424a73546ce9bc7
messages.subject: Packages not found when I run an app on my shiny-server (but availabe in Rstudioserver)
parts:
Hi

I have an app which runs fine in RStudio server, but if I run it in shiny-server (port 3838, on an Ubunutu 14.04 Digital Ocean droplet) I get "An error has occuredThe application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization."  When I look in the log it tells me that a package can't be found (in this case tidyserve). However, using RStudio Server I can load this package without problems.

Any help would be appreciated.


Thanks

Renger

messages.author: a424a73546ce9bc7
messages.subject: Re: Packages not found when I run an app on my shiny-server (but availabe in Rstudioserver)
parts:
I found the solution: I had packages installed  under my username with Rstudio Server. When I also installed them as root, everything worked again.
Cheers
Renger
